Definition: a mongrel, i.e. born of a Jewish father and a heathen mother
BiblicalUsage: mamzêr is a child of mixed and forbidden parentage, rendered bastard, and it occurs twice. In Deuteronomy 23:2 such a one shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD, even to his tenth generation, and in Zechariah 9:6 a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod as God cuts off the pride of the Philistines. The word draws a hard line around the congregation.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe mamzêr shows me how seriously God guards His people, and I hold that the line He drew in the old covenant is answered in Christ, who opens the congregation to all who come.
